crossRefs.note: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him…
especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me…
But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

translations.web: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;
translations.bsb: Then I took the deed of purchase—the sealed copy with its terms and conditions, as well as the open copy—
translations.kjv: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
translations.asv: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
